pins.model_dir_assembly: hardlinks of the 48 HF shards + index + tokenizer files; exl3_moe_plan.json = plugin tools/make_plan.py --uniform 3 (95.46 GiB experts per rank at TP2); config.json quantization_config.quant_method deepseek_v41_exl3 + exl3_moe block {plan_file, decode_kernel coop, coop_max_tokens 32, fused_rows 256, tp_layout channels, exllamav3_version 1.6.0}; fmt/activation_scheme/scale_fmt/weight_block_size/expert_dtype copied from the pack's non_routed_quantization block
pins.launcher_env_final: HEAD=<node-a> WORKER=<node-b> FAB_IF=<fabric-if> FAB_HCA=<fabric-rdma-dev> MODEL_DIR=<model-dir> MAX_LEN=32768 MAX_SEQS=1 MAX_BATCH=512 KV_BYTES=1073741824 INDEXER_LOGITS_MB=128 EXPANDABLE_SEGMENTS=1 DOCKER_ENV="VLLM_EXL3_HEAD=mxfp8 VLLM_DSPARK_ROUND_MS=37.7,42.1,46.3,49.9,53.0,55.6" ./scripts/launch/dsv41_tp2.sh up  (RECIPE_ENV = launcher default; depth policy falls back to conf because the pack ships no dspark_conf_feat_head.npz; TEXT_ONLY=1 default)
pins.host_prep: gb10-mem-guard and k3s agent stopped; sync; echo 3 > /proc/sys/vm/drop_caches; echo 1 > /proc/sys/vm/compact_memory (both nodes, before the first boot). No power cap or clock change; stock DGX OS power mode
pins.metric: kit_bench.py decode --set b --tokens 384: greedy, thinking off, 64-token warm-up then N reps per prompt, decode tok/s = completion tokens / decode seconds from the stream, median over reps; prefill: 8,192-token prompt, prompt tokens / TTFT. Acceptance = delta of vLLM /metrics spec_decode counters around the run
